The '''Marfa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marfa]], which was the site of a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|AgriCorps]] facility during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Red Harvest" />
